_README: Bundled deterministic quality-probe set for run_quality(mode='probe'). Every probe is graded by exact or regex match against `expected` at temperature=0 so results are reproducible and backend-agnostic (no logprobs required). Categories: arithmetic, factual, format (JSON-following) and instruction (instruction-following). Kept small so a probe run is cheap.

probes.prompt: Compute 17 + 26. Reply with only the number.
Compute 12 * 12. Reply with only the number.
Compute 100 - 37. Reply with only the number.
What is the capital of France? Reply with only the city name.
Which planet is known as the Red Planet? Reply with only the planet name.
What is the chemical formula for water? Reply with only the formula.
Return a JSON object with key "answer" whose value is the string "ok". Reply with only the JSON.
Return a JSON object with key "count" whose value is the number 3. Reply with only the JSON.
Reply with exactly the word HELLO in all uppercase letters and nothing else.
Respond with exactly the single word: yes
